title: George Possible NDE 6368
content: The first thing that I remember is I was being confined or locked up in a room, unsure of where I was, and someone was taking care me and administered a shot. I heard suspicious voices talking in the background, saying 'He won't know anything that has happened, he will just pass on'. All of a sudden, the next thing I know I was in a clear plastic capsule and brought to the military unit, to a sergeant. I was taken out of the plastic tube and was placed on something that I would describe as a slab (escalator/elevator in movement). I told my sergeant that someone gave me a shot and made it look like it was just my time to go. 'I know that I am not dead,' I told the sergeant. 'Because I remember clearly that they gave me a shot and what they were saying after they gave me the shot. So can you investigate this and make sure I am not dead and look into this suspicious matter?' The sergeant looks into it and comes back and says 'George, you are fine and you're all set, I will send you upstairs and tell them what you told me'. Then this slab goes up and takes me to, what I would describe as, heaven. Lying on the slab and looking up at this vision, I see young people all dressed in white and children up above in the clouds, waving their hands. They may not have been waving but instead doing something with their hands. The children looked like images that were penciled in, but with only their face and hands, and no body was visible in the images. I then looked down (not that I was higher up or far above them), so I just glanced down at them. I see people were floating on the sides of this tunnel. The people were all white. They were all facing and drifting towards the bright light that I call a 'bulb'. The people disappeared into that light/bulb. They were floating towards it but their feet weren't moving, similar to an escalator and traveling very slowly. One guy on left hand side of wall turned around and looked at me, he looked familiar and he was the only one that turned around to look at me, and then turned back. I am not sure who this person was, only that he looked familiar. After that, I went back down to the bottom floor, and they said 'George, while you are here, we want you to fill out this information. Write all of it down, so when you come back here, you won't have to do this again.' I just knew that I could bypass this part of equation and go directly to the bulb/light next time. The tunnel people disappeared into the light: they were floating but their feet weren't moving. This event was so real to me that it doesn't seem like it could have been any dream. I was in the operating room for what they told me 16-18 hours. They were going to give up on me but they didn't.

tunnel.movement_other_detail: People were floating toward the bright light very slowly, like on an escalator, with feet not moving.

arrival.other_being_detail: Saw 'young people all dressed in white' and 'children up above in the clouds' (faces and hands visible, no bodies). Also saw people floating along the sides of the tunnel toward a bright light/bulb; one familiar-looking person turned and looked at him.

environment.environment_other_detail: Clear plastic capsule/tube; a moving slab like an escalator/elevator; clouds with children above; tunnel walls with floating people.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: After going 'upstairs' toward what he described as heaven/the tunnel and light, he 'went back down to the bottom floor'.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Also described being in a clear plastic capsule/tube, taken to a sergeant, and later being asked to fill out information 'so when you come back here, you won't have to do this again.'
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Narrative includes confinement/shot, then capsule/tube to military unit/sergeant, then moving slab 'upstairs' into a tunnel with people drifting toward a bright light/bulb, then returning 'back down to the bottom floor' and being asked to write information.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Military/administrative framing: taken in a clear plastic capsule to a sergeant; told he was 'all set' and would be sent 'upstairs'; after returning, asked to fill out information so he wouldn't have to do it again when he came back.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: 'He won't know anything that has happened, he will just pass on'. 'I know that I am not dead,' ... 'George, you are fine and you're all set, I will send you upstairs...' 'George, while you are here, we want you to fill out this information. Write all of it down, so when you come back here, you won't have to do this again.'
